narrative:

The fact that you have received other job opportunities worked in the opposite direction, modestly encouraging the model to think you might stay, but it was not enough to outweigh the other signals. Finally, working in the “other” sector also nudged the prediction slightly toward leaving; this sector shows a noticeably lower retention rate than fields like medical or education.

Taken together, these elements led the model to conclude you are more likely to move on than to build a long career here. You may want to discuss your career goals openly with your manager so both sides can address the concerns the model has highlighted.
